description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance Payable to Workers Month of October 2024
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in specific trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper), which falls under public sector service conditions and benefits. It is issued by the Commissioner General of Labour under the Wages Boards Ordinance, making it a public service administrative matter rather than a government structural/personnel change or specialized category like commercial or legal.
